about.label: Sol today
about.text: Real spaceflight from 1957 to now: every orbital launch, every station, every craft that left Earth orbit and every landing on another world, with a flight log for every craft that left Earth orbit (full detail for the showcase missions). Real craft are assembled from their real parts.
about.note: Track RS (handover/design/SSE4-real-spaceflight-feasibility.md). Published on Explorers, not built into SSE4; the onboarding tour uses it to teach loading a pack.

calendar.name: Gregorian (UTC days, read on TT)
calendar.about: Days start at midnight UTC on J2000's day, counted on the universe clock (TT); TT runs about a minute ahead of UTC since 1972 (64.2 s in 2000), so a time within that minute of midnight may read as the next day. Years before 2000 count back with the same leap rule (proleptic Gregorian).
